data.action: 仰头调试机甲臂的管线
data.description: 【森蚺 · 机甲工坊】巨大开阔的罗德岛工程机库内，身穿工装热裤的阿达克里斯少女森蚺正仰着头，熟练地用扳手调试着巨型机甲‘丑东西’粗壮机械臂的液压管线。她抹了一把脸上的机油开心地笑了起来——「博士快看！动力核心的输出功率又提升了百分之十五！这就是钢铁与机械的终极浪漫！」
data.promptProse: Eunectes looks upward while turning a heavy wrench on the giant mech arm's hydraulic lines, oil marking her focused face. Dark-green halter top, grey-green sleeveless tactical vest, leather shorts and heavy work boots retain her mechanical outfit. The low medium view follows pipes into the overhead frame, hangar structures behind. Bright workshop lamps glint on fittings and wrench surfaces, casting narrow pipe shadows across the arm and softer shade beneath the machinery.
data.title: 森蚺 · 机甲工坊
